method.method: Per-stock quantiles of previous-year out-of-sample residuals divided by ex-ante 20/60-day mixed volatility scale
method.quantile_method: numpy linear empirical quantiles; no guaranteed conformal coverage
method.calibration: Previous calendar year, labels matured before test year minus 20 calendar days; every sixth eligible date
method.scope: Historical conditional reconstruction with observed shocks supplied retrospectively; not validation of arbitrary hypothetical scenarios
